goal: Users can run a responsive DOCX build with ordered progress, cooperative cancellation, retry, stale-result suppression, actionable failures, and preservation of the last valid output across Web, macOS, and Windows.
non_goals: Do not force-kill a shared sidecar or worker as the cancellation mechanism.
Do not change parser syntax or IDs, validation rules, template schema/resolution, compiler numbering, bibliography semantics, renderer behavior, DOCX/OOXML output, or preview semantics.
Do not implement queues, persistence, accounts, databases, AI, telemetry, signing, notarization, installers, or Slice 008 distribution acceptance.
expected_evidence: Strict RED and GREEN for cancellation before parse, validate, compile, render, finalize, package validation, and final atomic replacement
Application tests proving callback, renderer, package validation, replacement, and cancellation failures preserve prior output and clean temporary files
Adapter tests proving ordered JSON-safe progress and exactly one terminal success or typed error event
Web stream tests proving incremental progress, AbortSignal propagation, disconnect cancellation, and no stale terminal application
Tauri/Rust tests proving asynchronous sidecar event forwarding, request identity, cancellation signaling, and protocol parity
Reducer tests for ordered progress, repeated-click suppression, cancellation, retry, output preservation, and stale progress/success/error/output suppression
React tests for progress, cancel/retry controls, actionable error copy, final output feedback, and retained prior output
Browser and Tauri E2E coverage for successful build, cancel, retry, stale completion, and recovery
Frontend unit/typecheck/lint/build/E2E and focused/full Python regression evidence
Ruff, pip check, Cargo fmt/test/check, strict OpenSpec, SpecNav entry, CodeGraph, JSON, and whitespace evidence
Task report, dedicated spec review, and dedicated quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A third-party renderer can be interrupted safely in the middle of a call.
Canceling one build permits terminating a shared sidecar process.
Completion order is sufficient without request identity and generation gating.
Clearing frontend operation state prevents output replacement.
Canceled or failed rebuilds may clear the last valid output.
stop_condition: Stop if safe cancellation requires process killing, application-stage duplication in adapters, runtime ownership in React, parser/validator/template/compiler/renderer/DOCX changes, an event stream without terminal/request guarantees, stale events that can replace output, or Slice 008 release work.
